description:
**Due to the high level of interest in this property, please submit all enquiries via this website** Ritz Properties are delighted to offer to the market this well presented recently refurbished one bedroom modern apartment.

The flat briefly comprises a modern fully fitted open plan kitchen / living room, a large double bedroom and a fully fitted three piece shower room suite. The property is ideally located close to great schools, easy access into the city centre via the Ring Road access to the A61 and is within walking distance of St James's Hospital.

Rent £725 PCM / Deposit £825 / Available Now / EPC - D / Council Tax Band - A / Furnished.
